bundle.shortDescription: Systematic literature reviews, conducted with rigor and on your own machine.
bundle.longDescription: Fangio is a desktop application for conducting systematic literature reviews following the SPAR-4-SLR protocol and PRISMA 2020 guidelines. All inference runs on your local machine via LM Studio; nothing about your research leaves your laptop unless you explicitly enable an institutional database connector.
